xmldoc.short_description: Convert RGB color values to YCbCr color values.

param_input_item.param_description: m-by-n-by-3 RGB image, or c-by-3 double colormap with values in the range [0, 1].

param_output_item.param_description: YCbCr image or colormap. uint8, uint16, and single inputs preserve their class; other inputs return double.

description.p: Convert RGB color values to YCbCr color values. Inputs can be m-by-n-by-3 images or c-by-3 double colormaps with values in the range [0, 1].

example_item.example_item_description: Display luminance after RGB to YCbCr conversion
